author: Prem Thakker
content:

Good morning friends! **Prem** here. Today, I bring you **new** details about
how the Trump-Vance administration is commemorating Oct. 7: by holding an
anti-Zionist rabbi in detention, using similar logic to that used to keep the
student protester **Mahmoud Khalil** and the student op-ed writer **R umeysa
Özturk** in detention last year.

And so, today's **' First Draft'** lays out how a rabbi is being stopped from
celebrating the Jewish holidays, because he protested against Israel. We'll
also take a look at trouble in Trumpland over advisers working in a pro-Russia
Balkan enclave even as midterms catastrophe looms, and catch up with all the
news about Trump's illegal war with Iran.

Donald Trump's administration, which is trying to deport the former Columbia
student [Mahmoud Khalil](https://zeteo.com/p/the-moment-we-are-hopeless-they-
win?utm_campaign=23234856710&utm_source=google_ads&utm_medium=cpc&utm_content=189841814802-782839857508&utm_term=&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=23234856710&gbraid=0AAAAA-F9BawGz1cHjj3Qr8SJQB7RsLzz4&gclid=CjwKCAjw25fWBhAVEiwAMopNjp6zZ3z6ZFQHDQd0o3EAt5DP4bReSU2Ujq9gIQ8QEoM3L8vtXDtzvRoCzkQQAvD_BwE)
for protesting against Israel - by smearing him as an antisemitic threat - is
trying to deport an anti-Zionist rabbi for the same reason.

As the Trump-Vance administration rolls out what it calls a [nationwide
tour](https://x.com/TheJusticeDept/status/2107854215200620755?s=20) to combat
hate and antisemitism, it is simultaneously denying the rabbi religious
accommodations and making him pray during Jewish Holy Days next to a toilet,
as he languishes in ICE detention.

It's another awful line on the villainous resume of this White House of
Horrors.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Yehnotan Ovadia is a 35-year-old Orthodox Jewish religious teacher and rabbi
who came to the U.S. in 2022 on a religious worker visa. As a member of the
anti-Zionist Satmar Hasidic community, which opposes the state of Israel on
religious grounds, he participated in pro-Palestine and anti-Israel
demonstrations in New York.

Now in detention arising from such protests, Ovadia alleges in new filings
seen by **Zeteo** that ICE is subjecting him to conditions that make it
impossible to observe his faith. He notes that he has been detained through
Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, and Sukkot; has resolved to use blankets to
separate himself from the cell toilet and his new cellmate while he prays; and
claims he has lost 25 pounds in about a month.
